svg.title: EDISON-G system architecture: energy flows and main components
svg.desc: Solar PV, optional wind and battery storage connect through converters to a common DC bus. A bidirectional PCS links the DC bus to AC distribution, on-site consumers and the public grid; a DC/DC unit supplies high-power EV charging. An EMS monitors and controls the system.
svg.text: Monitoring · dispatch optimisation · peak shaving · protection coordination
